Cc: contracts@edgeshift.io
Date: 2027-06-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership proposal — embedded offering commercial framework

Hi Stephanie,

Great chatting earlier. As promised, attaching a short commercial outline for EdgeShift's embedded search/observability module we'd like to bundle into Redwood's hosted flow. High level asks from our side:

- Revenue share on net ARR (post-trial) for co-sold and referred deals
- Lead registration protection for introductions we bring for 12 months
- Marketing co-funding for first 12 co-marketed accounts

I've attached a draft MSA (v3) with our standard reseller language and a simple pricing workbook. Could you review and tell me where Redwood typically lands on split for first 50-100 seats (we're thinking to seed with 50 pilot seats)?

Happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk through.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | EdgeShift

Subject: Re: Partnership proposal — embedded offering commercial framework

Thanks Liam — appreciate the deck and the MSA. Looping in Ben (Sales) and Marissa (Partner Ops) to align on revenue mechanics and lead registration. A few quick clarifying items before legal redlines: 

- Lead registration: Redwood policy is a 180-day protected window for active registration; for ISV-embedded deals we can agree to 12 months if we define an intro maturity milestone. Can you propose the intro criteria you expect?
- Revenue share cadence: do you want split on gross ARR or net after discounts?
- Pilots: for the first 50 seats we typically recommend a trial discount with a defined conversion trigger (e.g., 60% converting within 90 days).

If you can confirm those points I can get Legal to do a redline of your MSA and we can prepare a short SOW for a pilot (30–90 days). Prefer to resolve commercial points this week.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Strategic Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Stephanie — quick answers inline: 

- Intro criteria: a documented demo + warm intro email from an EdgeShift AE + account size > $50k ARR expected within 12 months.
- Split: EdgeShift prefers revenue share on net ARR after discounts and credits. Our asks: 70/30 in EdgeShift's favor for the first 50 converted seats (we'll cover implementation support), then revert to 60/40 for ongoing deals.
- Pilot conversion: we are comfortable with a 45-60 day pilot and a 50% conversion trigger for Redwood credits toward the pilot cost.

I've re-attached the MSA and added a short SOW template for the pilot as attachments. If those commercial guardrails are acceptable, we'll send procurement details and a DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks,
Liam

Subject: Re: Partnership proposal — embedded offering commercial framework

Thanks — I reviewed EdgeShift's proposal. Commercial thoughts: 

- 70/30 in EdgeShift's favor for first 50 sounds aggressive for us given revenue capture, but acceptable as a time-bound incentive if we require:
  - Co-sell attribution rules (HubSpot requirement + signed order with Redwood product SKU),
  - Lead registration form + onboarding playbook submitted within 7 days of intro, and
  - A shared CS lead to ensure product integrity.
- Recommend we define "net ARR" explicitly (exclude taxes, include discounts applied at contract signing).
- Proposal: 65/35 for first 50 deals (EdgeShift 65%) with a performance kicker: if >70% of pilot accounts convert to paid within 90 days, EdgeShift gets an additional 3% for that cohort.

Operational asks for Partner Ops: Marissa, can you draft the lead registration form & a short onboarding checklist? Put HubSpot record AS-ES-1187 on the registration form.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the counter. We can accept a time-boxed 65/35 for the first 50 converting seats provided the performance kicker is limited to the pilot cohort only and that lead registration protections are robust (12 months as discussed). Two small asks from procurement:

- An audit clause to validate reported ARR for the first 12 months (we'll accept a standard 30-day audit notice)
- Payment terms: Net 30 for partner payouts; we prefer monthly settlement rather than quarterly.

I'll get our procurement team to confirm these and then we'll push a clean MSA into DocuSign.

Regards,
Liam

1) Commercial: agree 65/35 EdgeShift/Redwood for first 50 converting seats (EdgeShift 65%) with the pilot performance kicker (+3%) if >70% conversion to paid in 90 days. After the cohort, split moves to 60/40. Ben to confirm final acceptance verbally with Liam this week.
